title: French-Style Frankfurter Dumplings
description: A twist on traditional French cuisine, this hearty dish combines the flavors of Malaysia with the comfort of a classic frankfurter and dumplings.

ingredients.name: Frankfurter
ingredients.notes: preferably homemade or from a reputable source

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and egg to make the dumpling dough.
Gradually add water while mixing until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Divide the dough into small balls, about the size of a small egg.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a frankfurter in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the frankfurter to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat with the remaining dough and frankfurters.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Add the Malaysian chili sauce, garlic, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
Stir the ingredients together and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce is bubbly and fragrant.
Serve the dumplings hot with the sauce spooned over the top.
